description: Learn the NATO phonetic alphabet with flashcards, a typing quiz and a word-spelling practice mode.

faqs.a: This trainer uses the official ITU/NATO spellings: Alfa, Juliett and X-ray — the spellings designed to avoid mispronunciation over radio.
Yes — pilots, air-traffic control, military radio operators and emergency services use it worldwide to spell names and call signs clearly.
faqs.q: Who uses the NATO phonetic alphabet?

faqs.a: Your score is kept only in this browser tab while you practice. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
faqs.q: Is my quiz score saved anywhere?

howto: Pick Learn to flip through flashcards of all 26 letters.
Switch to Quiz and type the NATO word for each shown letter.
Try Spell mode: enter any word to see its NATO spelling.
Track your score and retry the letters you miss.
title: NATO Phonetic Alphabet Trainer
